title: Hero Section Animated Typing Effect and Call-to-Action Buttons
description: Verify that the Hero Section displays an animated typing effect smoothly without glitches and that all call-to-action buttons are visible, clickable, and navigate to the correct sections or links.

steps.description: Load the homepage and navigate to the Hero Section.
Confirm that the typing animation plays smoothly and completes correctly.
Check that all call-to-action buttons are visible and enabled.
Click each call-to-action button.
Verify each button navigates as expected without errors.

title: About Me Section Animated Feature Cards and Skill Badges
description: Validate that the About Me Section displays animated feature cards and skill badges with correct content and animations working properly on desktop and mobile devices.

steps.description: Navigate to the About Me Section on desktop.
Verify all feature cards are visible and their animations play on appearance.
Ensure the skill badges are displayed correctly with animated effects.
Repeat above steps on a mobile device or responsive viewport.
Confirm animations and content render and function correctly on mobile.

title: Skills Section Interactive Display and Category Filtering
description: Test the Skills Section for proper loading of skills, responsive hover effects, and correct filtering functionality by categories.

steps.description: Navigate to the Skills Section.
Confirm all skill badges are loaded and visible.
Hover over various skill badges.
Verify hover effects trigger properly and smoothly.
Use the category filter controls to filter skills.
Check that only skills from the selected category are displayed, and others are hidden.
Clear filters and verify all skills reappear.

title: Projects Section Filtering and Detailed Project Views
description: Ensure the Projects Section displays project cards properly, supports filtering by categories, and detailed project views show correct information.

steps.description: Navigate to the Projects Section.
Verify all project cards load and are visible.
Apply project category filters.
Validate that only projects matching the filter criteria are displayed.
Click on a project card to open its detailed view.
Confirm detailed project information, images, and descriptions are displayed correctly.
Close the detailed project view.
Verify return to projects listing without errors.

title: Experience Section Timeline Rendering and Certifications Display
description: Check if the Experience Section shows a timeline with work experience and internships correctly, includes certifications, and animations render smoothly.

steps.description: Navigate to the Experience Section.
Verify timeline items appear in correct chronological order.
Check that each work or internship entry contains accurate details.
Confirm certifications appear associated with the relevant timeline entries.
Ensure timeline animations and transitions function smoothly on scroll.

title: Publications Section Image Optimization and Display
description: Verify the Publications Section lists research publications correctly with images optimized for quality and performance, loading efficiently with no distortion.

steps.description: Navigate to the Publications Section.
Confirm all publications are listed with correct titles and descriptions.
Check that publication images load quickly and are optimized without visual artifacts.
Verify images are responsive and scale appropriately on different devices.

title: Contact Section Form Submission and Email Integration
description: Test the Contact Section's contact form for input validation, submission functionality, backend API integration, email sending, and display of feedback messages.

steps.description: Navigate to the Contact Section.
Input valid contact form data including name, email, subject, and message.
Submit the contact form.
Verify user feedback confirms successful submission.
Confirm backend API receives form data and triggers email sending.
Submit the contact form with missing required fields.
Validate proper error messages appear and form is not submitted.
Test social media links are visible and clickable.
Confirm each link opens the correct social media page in a new tab.

title: Responsive Navigation Menu and Smooth Scrolling
description: Ensure the navigation components function responsively including mobile menu toggling, correct link behavior, and smooth scrolling animations between sections.

steps.description: Load the website on a desktop viewport.
Click each navigation menu link.
Verify smooth scroll transitions to corresponding sections.
Resize viewport or use a mobile device.
Toggle mobile menu open and close.
Confirm mobile menu displays and hides correctly.
Use mobile menu links to navigate.
Check smooth scrolling and menu closes after navigation.

title: Animations Performance and Visual Quality
description: Test all advanced animations implemented with Framer Motion and GSAP across the site for smoothness, absence of flickers or delays, and consistency on multiple device types.

steps.description: Navigate through all site sections experiencing animations (Hero, About Me, Skills, Projects, Experience, etc.).
Confirm animations render fluidly with no dropped frames or glitches.
Validate that animation timing and easing function as designed.
Test animations on different devices including low-performance mobiles.
Confirm animations maintain acceptable performance and do not cause janks.

title: Error Boundary Handling for UI Failures
description: Verify that the error boundary component catches potential UI errors gracefully and displays fallback UI without breaking the overall user experience.

steps.description: Simulate errors in various UI components (e.g., deliberately throw exceptions in child components).
Validate that errors are caught by error boundaries.
Confirm fallback UI is shown with appropriate messaging.
Check that the rest of the application remains functional and navigable.

title: Performance Metrics and Loading Times
description: Measure site loading times, interaction responsiveness, and validate that performance monitoring utilities capture correct data according to benchmarks.

steps.description: Load the website on various devices and networks.
Measure full load time and ensure it meets predefined benchmarks.
Interact with interactive sections like filtering projects and skills.
Verify UI responses occur within acceptable latency.
Confirm performance monitoring utilities report accurate metrics.

title: Reusable UI Components Consistency and Functional Test
description: Test reusable components such as loaders, buttons, custom cursors, and social links for visual consistency, interaction correctness, and proper animation execution.

steps.description: Navigate through various pages and sections that use these UI components.
Check that loaders show appropriately with animation during data loading.
Click various buttons to ensure correct behavior and visual feedback.
Validate custom cursors appear and move smoothly.
Hover and click social media links.
Confirm links open correct pages and UI consistency is maintained.
